cues.text: Section fourteen.
Complete Session 01 archived question bank.
Read the lesson first, then use these questions as worked revision.
The original archive wording, numbering and option order are retained.
This bank includes three pre-test questions and twenty-nine CA-matched questions that are directly supported by the Session 01 materials.
Repeated and shuffled items are retained deliberately.
Questions that belong mainly to later sessions are excluded, including Pre-test Question 10 and CA Question 8.
Please remember that the answers given here are tutor-suggested, not official marking.
Part A.
Pre-semester test.
Pre-test Question 1.
Strategic alignment in IT ensures that, blank.
Option a.
Technology initiatives support and reflect the broader business direction.
Option b.
Projects are executed based on available IT skills rather than organisational need.
Option c.
Innovation is prioritised over compliance and structure.
Option d.
Technical teams manage projects with complete autonomy from leadership.
The suggested answer is a.
Strategic alignment makes IT initiatives serve organisational strategy and business objectives.
Pre-test Question 2.
A platform business model in a digital ecosystem primarily enables enterprises to, blank.
Option a.
Consolidate all IT operations within one internal data centre.
Option b.
Eliminate the need for IT governance structures.
Option c.
Generate value by facilitating interactions between external producers and consumers.
Option d.
Avoid regulatory oversight by decentralising their services.
The suggested answer is c.
A platform facilitates exchanges between different participants, for example sellers and buyers.
Pre-test Question 4.
Which of the following is the most accurate description of how ERP systems improve operational efficiency?
Option a.
They block unauthorised internet access in the office.
Option b.
They centralise data and automate business processes across departments.
Option c.
They serve as internal messaging platforms.
Option d.
They replace the need for customer service agents.
The suggested answer is b.
Enterprise Resource Planning integrates cross-departmental data and automates workflows.
Part B.
CA-matched test questions.
CA Question 1.

Following ransomware preparedness exercises conducted at Rack Centre Data Infrastructure Limited, executives instructed IT teams to create formal disaster recovery documentation and incident response procedures.
Which management function is MOST directly demonstrated?
Option A.
Organising through departmental restructuring and reporting alignment controls.
Option B.
Directing through continuous employee engagement and communication activities.
Option C.
Planning through development of risk mitigation and recovery strategies.
Option D.
Staffing through workforce expansion and specialised talent acquisition efforts.
The suggested answer is C.
Preparing recovery procedures establishes future actions, which is planning.
CA Question 3.
Within an operational resilience exercise at Zenith Bank Nigeria Plc, cybersecurity analysts identified phishing attacks targeting online banking customers.
Which IT management principle is MOST directly involved in mitigating this threat?
Option A.
Resource coordination through strategic outsourcing of IT operations.
Option B.
Performance optimisation through centralised monitoring dashboards.
Option C.
Value delivery through customer acquisition and product diversification.
Option D.
Risk management through proactive identification of cybersecurity threats.
The suggested answer is D.
Phishing is a security threat; identifying and mitigating it is risk management.
